pr_title: Project: show referenced PRs in issue cards
pr_body:
This PR slightly modifies the project view to include information about related PRs in issue cards.

A link to related PRs is included, and the PR icon is colored according to the PR status.

Since linked PRs are not included in the `Issue` object, right now they are fetched by the Project controller, by fetching the comments from the issue list, and later the PR themselves. Then, a simple map from issue ID to a list of related issues (PRs) is created and passed to the template. This is likely not the most elegant way to do it, and I am open to suggestions on how to improve it without messing too much with the models. Perhaps an alternative could be to create a `ProjectIssue` class that embeds `Issue`, and contains the list of linked PRs obtained in the same way.

Additionally, I have also slightly increased the top padding of the issue title, since it seemed a bit off to me. I can drop this commit if you think it is too unrelated or undesired.

Please tell me what you think!

![Screenshot 2020-12-29 at 15 37 00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/969721/103291969-231b4a80-49ed-11eb-96bd-9955365e9db4.png)
![Screenshot 2020-12-29 at 15 37 06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/969721/103291972-244c7780-49ed-11eb-9731-02d6b599272d.png)

(With top padding corrected from 5px to 8px:)
![Screenshot 2020-12-29 at 15 40 35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/969721/103291975-24e50e00-49ed-11eb-83b7-7e89da947354.png)

---

Closes #14127

issue_context.title: Feature request: Show linked PRs (if any) in Projects
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): v1.13.0

## Description

At this moment, both PRs and Issues can be added to Projects, which I think it's a nice feature. However, issues being tracked in a Project do not reflect having any PRs attached to them. This makes navigation a bit cumbersome, specially if one is making use of the popular "Ready for review" column, as a reviewer has to navigate to the issue and then to the PR linked in it.

I think it would be nice if PRs showed as an add-in to issue cards in the Project view. This is similar to what github does.

## Screenshots

| How it looks now | How I think it could be improved (from Github.com) |
|---|---|
| ![Current state](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/969721/103005745-50ba4c80-4532-11eb-9302-d3b7979b4aa3.png)   | ![DeepinScreenshot_select-area_20201223152148](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/969721/103006795-99720580-4532-11eb-973b-44bca55387da.png) |
